```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
stage_levels <- c("FWD_DEMUX", "RC_REV_DEMUX", "REV_DEMUX", "RC_FWD_DEMUX")

run_info     <- read_tsv("run_info.tsv", col_types = "cc")
stage_counts <- read_tsv("stage_counts.tsv", col_types = "cccdd")
sample_stats <- read_tsv("sample_stats.tsv", col_types = "ccdddddd")
samples      <- read_tsv("samples_metadata.tsv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
```

## Run

```{r run-info}
kable(run_info)
```

## Stages

Each stage is one dorado demux run (stages 2 and 4 run once per parent barcode).

```{r stage-summary}
stage_summary <- stage_counts |>
  mutate(status = if_else(barcode == "unclassified", "unclassified", "classified")) |>
  group_by(stage, status) |>
  summarise(reads = sum(reads), .groups = "drop") |>
  complete(stage, status, fill = list(reads = 0)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = reads) |>
  mutate(
    total = classified + unclassified,
    pct_classified = round(100 * classified / total, 1)
  ) |>
  arrange(match(stage, stage_levels))

kable(
  stage_summary |> mutate(across(c(classified, unclassified, total), fmt)),
  col.names = c("Stage", "Classified reads", "Unclassified reads", "Total reads", "% classified")
)
```

### Stage 1: forward primer, front barcode

```{r stage1}
stage_counts |>
  filter(stage == "FWD_DEMUX") |>
  ggplot(aes(barcode, reads)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "reads") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### Stage 2 and 4: rear barcode per front barcode

Rows are the parent (front) barcode, columns the rear barcode found in it.

```{r rc-heatmap}
rc_heatmap <- function(st, title) {
  d <- stage_counts |> filter(stage == st)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  ggplot(d, aes(barcode, parent, fill = reads)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = fmt(reads)), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue", labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(title = title, x = "rear barcode", y = "front barcode (parent)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}
rc_heatmap("RC_REV_DEMUX", "Forward reads: RC_REV_DEMUX")
rc_heatmap("RC_FWD_DEMUX", "Reverse reads: RC_FWD_DEMUX")
```

## Samples

```{r samples}
sample_report <- samples |>
  left_join(sample_stats, by = c("customer", "sample")) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(fwd_reads, fwd_bases, rev_reads, rev_bases, total_reads, total_bases), ~ coalesce(.x, 0)),
    mean_length = if_else(total_reads > 0, round(total_bases / total_reads), NA_real_),
    status = if_else(total_reads > 0, "ok", "NO READS")
  )

input_reads <- stage_summary |> filter(stage == "FWD_DEMUX") |> pull(total) |> sum()
in_samples  <- sum(sample_report$total_reads)
candidates  <- stage_summary |> filter(stage %in% c("RC_REV_DEMUX", "RC_FWD_DEMUX")) |> pull(classified) |> sum()

overview <- tibble(
  metric = c(
    "Input reads",
    "Reads assigned to a sample in the metadata",
    "% of input reads in samples",
    "Reads fully demultiplexed but not in the metadata"
  ),
  value = c(
    fmt(input_reads),
    fmt(in_samples),
    if (input_reads > 0) as.character(round(100 * in_samples / input_reads, 1)) else NA_character_,
    fmt(max(candidates - in_samples, 0))
  )
)
kable(overview, col.names = c("", ""))
```

```{r sample-table}
sample_report |>
  select(customer, sample, status, fwd_reads, rev_reads, total_reads, mean_length) |>
  mutate(across(c(fwd_reads, rev_reads, total_reads), fmt)) |>
  kable(col.names = c("Customer", "Sample", "Status", "Forward reads", "Reverse reads", "Total reads", "Mean length (bp)"))
```

```{r sample-plot, fig.height = 5}
sample_report |>
  select(customer, sample, forward = fwd_reads, reverse = rev_reads) |>
  pivot_longer(c(forward, reverse), names_to = "orientation", values_to = "reads") |>
  ggplot(aes(sample, reads, fill = orientation)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~customer, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "reads") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))
```

```{r no-reads}
missing <- sample_report |> filter(total_reads == 0)
if (nrow(missing) > 0) {
  cat("**Samples without reads:**", paste(paste(missing$customer, missing$sample, sep = "/"), collapse = ", "))
}
```
